annotations.title: Save a new draft of a ChatGPT Ads lead form

description: Save a NEW DRAFT REVISION of a ChatGPT Ads lead form (the whole definition: name + fields are replaced). expectedDraftRevisionId must be the draftRevisionId you last read — ChatGPT Ads refuses a stale one so two editors cannot clobber each other. The published version is untouched until publish_openai_ads_lead_form.

expectedDraftRevisionId.description: draftRevisionId from the last read; refused if stale

fields.description: all form questions in order; replaces the whole field list

fieldId.description: your stable key for the field, e.g. email

label.description: question text shown to the person

required.description: true = the person must answer this question

name.description: lead form name; the whole definition is replaced

privacyPolicyUrl.description: privacy policy URL shown with the form

name: update_openai_ads_lead_form
title: Save a new draft of a ChatGPT Ads lead form
